fields.description: Issue includes local political commentary and civic criticism focused on Florida Governor Dave Sholtz and the closing of bars in Dade County amid debates over prohibition enforcement and proposals for state-controlled liquor stores; discussion of gambling and law enforcement in South Florida. Regular columns and society notes appear alongside extensive coverage and advertising related to Tropical Park racing (including tips and results), Miami and Miami Beach nightlife and entertainment venues, and local business promotions; includes radio program schedules.
